{{Top}}
'''Sodium''' existed in [[Salt/Legends|salt]] [[Water/Legends|water]] on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. On other worlds such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] it was found in the form of sodium sand, mixed with fine mineral particles.

Processed sodium sand was used in several [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]]s and glues used in industrial construction. Caused by the heavy competition between the sodium sand-rich worlds and the existence of a dozen other substitutes, the market value of sodium sand was in constant flux.
